text:
Tuesday, Aug. 18: Clearwater Threshers beat Dunedin Blue Jays 8-4; former Homestead High standout William Vierling played
By
A. E. GironOn Tuesday, Aug. 18, at 6:30 p.m., the Clearwater Threshers, the current team of former Homestead High School standout William Vierling, defeated the Dunedin Blue Jays 8-4 in a minor league game.
The game took place at BayCare Ballpark. It was the 15th meeting between the teams this season, with the Threshers holding an 11-4 advantage in the season series against the Blue Jays.
Vierling went 1-for-4, scored one run, recorded an RBI and left three runners on base.
The Threshers’ next game is scheduled for Wednesday, Aug. 19, at BayCare Ballpark against the Clearwater Threshers.
William Vierling — Catcher — 6′1″ — 215 — Hometown: Milwaukee
